result.instructions: Tools for Scalefusion, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my managed devices and show each one's battery level."; "Which device is in the Field Sales group, and where was it last seen?"; "Lock the three devices I give you by id, then confirm their status.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Scalefusion data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run scalefusion_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run scalefusion_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run scalefusion_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. scalefusion_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: scalefusion_list_devices
tools.title: List managed devices
tools.description: List the devices managed by Scalefusion with their ids, names, status, battery, model and IMEI. Start here: the device ids feed most other tools. Developer API: GET /api/v1/devices.json.

tools.name: scalefusion_get_device
tools.title: Get device details
tools.description: Get the full record of one managed device: name, model, OS, status, group, profile, IMEI and serial number. Developer API: GET /api/v1/devices/{id}.json.

device_id.description: Device id, from scalefusion_list_devices or scalefusion_search_devices.

tools.name: scalefusion_search_devices
tools.title: Search devices by IMEI or serial number
tools.description: Find managed devices by IMEI or serial number. Give at least one of the two. Developer API: GET /api/v1/devices/search.json.

annotations.title: Search devices by IMEI or serial number

tools.name: scalefusion_get_device_battery
tools.title: Get device battery
tools.description: Get the battery level and charging information of one device. Developer API: GET /api/v1/devices/{id}/battery.json.

device_id.description: Device id, from scalefusion_list_devices or scalefusion_search_devices.

tools.name: scalefusion_get_device_locations
tools.title: Get last device locations
tools.description: Get the latest 10 recorded locations of one device. Location data is personal data: use it only for managed devices the user is allowed to track. Developer API: GET /api/v1/devices/{id}/locations.json.

device_id.description: Device id, from scalefusion_list_devices or scalefusion_search_devices.

tools.name: scalefusion_get_device_monthly_data_usage
tools.title: Get monthly data usage
tools.description: Get the mobile data usage of one Android or iOS device for the current month. Developer API: GET /api/v1/devices/{id}/monthly_data_usage.json.

device_id.description: Device id, from scalefusion_list_devices or scalefusion_search_devices.

tools.name: scalefusion_list_device_profiles
tools.title: List device profiles
tools.description: List the device profiles (policy sets) in the account with their ids and names. Developer API: GET /api/v1/device_profiles.json.

tools.name: scalefusion_list_device_groups
tools.title: List device groups
tools.description: List the device groups in the account with their ids, names and linked profile ids. Developer API: GET /api/v1/device_groups.json.

tools.name: scalefusion_lock_devices
tools.title: Lock devices
tools.description: LOCK one or more devices now: applies their policies, so the user cannot use the device normally until it is unlocked. Affects real devices in the field. Developer API: POST /api/v1/devices/lock.json (device_ids[]).

device_ids.description: One or more device ids, from scalefusion_list_devices.

tools.name: scalefusion_unlock_devices
tools.title: Unlock devices
tools.description: UNLOCK one or more devices now: relaxes their policies so the user can use the device again. Developer API: POST /api/v1/devices/unlock.json (device_ids[]).

device_ids.description: One or more device ids, from scalefusion_list_devices.

tools.name: scalefusion_reboot_device
tools.title: Reboot a device
tools.description: REBOOT one device now. Works only on supported devices. Unsaved work on the device can be lost. Developer API: PUT /api/v1/devices/{id}/reboot.json.

device_id.description: Device id, from scalefusion_list_devices or scalefusion_search_devices.

tools.name: scalefusion_change_device_group
tools.title: Move a device to another group
tools.description: MOVE one device to another device group. The group's profile policies then apply to the device. Developer API: POST /api/v1/devices/{id}/change_group.json (device[device_group_id]).

device_id.description: Device id, from scalefusion_list_devices or scalefusion_search_devices.

annotations.title: Move a device to another group

tools.name: scalefusion_update_exit_passcode
tools.title: Set a device exit passcode
tools.description: SET the exit passcode of one device that has no device profile. The new passcode replaces the old one; the user then needs it to leave managed mode. Developer API: POST /api/v1/devices/{id}/update_exit_passcode.json (passcode).

device_id.description: Device id, from scalefusion_list_devices or scalefusion_search_devices.

passcode.description: The new exit passcode. It is sent to Scalefusion and never echoed back.

tools.name: scalefusion_clear_app_data
tools.title: Clear app data on devices
tools.description: CLEAR the stored data of the listed apps on the listed devices (for example local caches and sign-ins). Unsaved app data is lost. Developer API: POST /api/v1/devices/clear_app_data.json (device_ids[], packages[]).

device_ids.description: One or more device ids, from scalefusion_list_devices.

packages.description: Android package names of the apps, for example com.example.app.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Scalefusion
prompts.description: What you can do with Scalefusion here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: see_the_managed_device_inventory
prompts.title: See the managed device inventory
prompts.description: The AI lists the devices managed by Scalefusion with their names, models, status and battery level. You see which devices are online and which need attention.

prompts.name: find_a_device_by_imei_or_serial_number
prompts.title: Find a device by IMEI or serial number
prompts.description: The AI searches the device inventory by IMEI or serial number and shows the matching device record, including its group and profile.

prompts.name: review_device_groups_and_profiles
prompts.title: Review device groups and profiles
prompts.description: The AI lists the device groups and device profiles in the account, so you see which policies apply to which devices.

prompts.name: lock_unlock_or_reboot_devices
prompts.title: Lock, unlock or reboot devices
prompts.description: The AI sends a lock, unlock or reboot command to the devices you name. These commands act on real devices in the field, so the AI asks you to confirm the device ids first.

prompts.name: move_a_device_to_another_group
prompts.title: Move a device to another group
prompts.description: The AI moves one device to another device group. The new group's profile policies then apply to that device.
